newsitem.title: USA: Coconino's Ad-HaTTeRs posts sales record.
newsitem.headline: Coconino's Ad-HaTTeRs posts sales record.

text.p: Coconino SMA Inc said Monday its subsidiary Ad-HaTTeRs posted record sales of $163,000 in June.

The manufacturer of air fresheners shipped more than 100,000 units in June, Coconino said in a statement. It added the subsidiary posted $376,000 in revenues in the quarter ended June 30, an 28 percent increase over the same period last year.
The subsidiary generated a "significant gross profit" for the quarter, Coconino said. The marketing company's stock traded at 1-1/4 Monday afternoon, down 5/8 and close to its 52-week low of 7/8.
